point: 2 DIFC Regulation 10 amendments: enacted or still consultation
finding: No enactment seen. The June 2026 DIFCA consultation paper (cover No. 3, body No. 2 of 2026; deadline 18 July 2026) says the proposed regulations are draft only and will take effect on a date to be published. It proposes edits to Reg 10.2.2(b), a Safety concept in 10.3.1(f), ASO duties in 10.3.3, and a new Reg 11 on recognised accreditation frameworks. The DIFC legal database page lists the Data Protection Regulations with no version or date and no Reg 11; its 2026 items are other regulations. Latest DP Regulations enactment news found is dated 7 Sep 2023.
locator_seen: Consultation paper: statement that proposed regulations are in draft form only; legal database listing (https://www.difc.com/business/laws-and-regulations/legal-database)
note: Evidence is absence of an enactment notice on pages that carry no dates, so the best reading is still consultation but it is not proven. Enactment news item read: https://www.difc.com/whats-on/news/difc-enacts-amended-data-protection-regulations (7 Sep 2023, earlier round).

point: 5 Korea AI Basic Act enforcement decree: current number and August 2026 change
finding: KLRI/law.go.kr revision history lists three versions: Decree 36053 (promulgated 21 Jan 2026, in force 22 Jan 2026, enactment); Decree 36506 (20 Jul 2026, in force 21 Jul 2026, partial amendment implementing amended AI Basic Act Act 21311: vulnerable groups Art 1-2, usage-cost support Art 15-2, AI research institutes Art 16-2); Decree 36580 (18 Aug 2026, in force 20 Aug 2026, listed as amendment through another law). The stated reason for 36580 concerns security rules for national R&D projects under the R&D Innovation Act decree, not AI-specific content. Current decree number is therefore 36580; the last AI-specific amendment is 36506.
locator_seen: Revision list entries for 36580, 36506 and 36053; current-version page https://www.law.go.kr/LSW/lsInfoP.do?lsId=015032
note: A July 2026 amendment (36506) was missing from the earlier record of 36053 as the latest. Whether 36580 touched articles 23-27 (transparency, safety, high-impact) was not shown; the listed reason mentions none. Article text not read.
